title: Guest Lecture — Testing Large Language Model (LLM) Applications
description: Seminar covering the challenges and strategies for testing LLM-based applications. The lecture explores the non-deterministic nature of LLMs, testing methods like prompt testing and metamorphic testing, verification approaches including evaluation benchmarks and LLM-as-a-Judge, and security testing focusing on jailbreaking and prompt injection defenses.

title: Guest Lecture — UML Modeling, Prototyping and GitHub Fundamentals
description: Lecture introducing the fundamentals of UML diagram creation with a hands-on demo of Visual Paradigm, the basics of software prototyping with Figma, and the core concepts of version control and collaboration with GitHub.

title: Guest Lecture — Software Configuration Management with GitHub
description: Lecture focused on practical GitHub examples for the software configuration management of software projects.
